name: Semantics
description:
The aim of this course is to understand the foundations of programming language semantics and use it to formally specify and prove correct properties about (simple) programming languages and programs. We will explore different approaches to specify the semantics of programming languages (operational, denotational, axiomatic). We will reason formally about semantic properties of programs and programing languages.

See the associated Moodle course for more information.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge in logic, discrete structures, and programming languages. Some mathematical maturity.
